AttachFailureJson.description: Why the daemon refused an attach or a create.

oneOf.description: Lowercase hex prefix, 1–32 digits, resolved daemon-side.

AttrRunJson.description: One pen applied to `len` consecutive columns.

len.description: Columns covered; `0` covers nothing and is not a run.

link.description:
1-based handle into the hyperlink registry `GridMsg::Hyperlink`
populates; `null` for an unlinked run.

AttributesJson.description:
One pen. `flags` is a bitmap, bit 0 bold through bit 10
ISO-protected (`docs/reference/row-codec.md` "Attribute runs").

underline_style.description: Meaningful only while the underline flag is set.

selection.description:
Bit 0 is the clipboard, bit 1 X11 PRIMARY
(`docs/reference/ipc.md`).

oneOf.description: The renderer's configured default for this channel.

ConnJson.description: Connection-family frames in their v1 form.

ConnectionModeJson.description: What a connection is allowed to say.

EnvBytesJson.description: One entry of a child's base environment, as raw platform bytes.

oneOf.description: Never written to; renders as a blank.

1-based handle into the cluster registry `GridMsg::Cluster`
populates.
Right half of a double-wide glyph in the previous column.
Continuation column of an OSC 66 sized run.

GridJson.description: Grid-family frames in their v1 form.

ImageJson.description: Image-family frames in their v1 form.

ImageTargetJson.description: What an [`ImageJson::Header`] opens a transfer for.

oneOf.description: Kitty's 1-based frame numbering; `0` is not a frame.

InputJson.description: Input-family frames in their v1 form.

KeyJson.description: The logical key a keystroke resolved to.

oneOf.description: A dead key or a bare modifier: no encoding of its own.

mods.description: Bits 0–2: shift, alt, ctrl. xterm has no Super bit.

px.description: Pixel column in the text area, 1-based.

py.description: Pixel row in the text area, 1-based.

PaletteActionJson.description: What a [`GridJson::PaletteColor`] does to its slot.

RefusalReasonJson.description: Why a daemon refused a connection.

RequestedDimsJson.description: Geometry a client asks for, before the daemon admits it.

RgbJson.description: A 24-bit color, as an object rather than the domain tuple.

RowCellsJson.description:
A row's cells. One encoding today: attribute runs over a flat
grapheme list, which is what the packed row stores.

attr_runs.description: Consecutive runs covering every grapheme exactly once.

graphemes.description: One entry per column, left to right.

soft_wrap_continued.description: The row continues into the next one without a newline.

RowJson.description:
One dirty row of a [`GridJson::RowDelta`]. The cells ride the
row codec's structural form (`docs/reference/row-codec.md`),
never the packed bytes the socket carries.

sequence.description: Creation sequence, minted by the daemon; never `0`.

SessionJson.description: Session-family frames in their v1 form.

SizedCellJson.description: The sizing that applies to one column of this row.

cell_width.description: `w`, 0..=7; `0` derives the width from the text.

frac_num.description: `n`, 0..=15 and below `frac_den` whenever that is non-zero.

SourceRectJson.description: Sub-region of an image, in image pixels.

dims.description: `null` asks for the daemon default geometry.

StreamErrorReasonJson.description: Why a request or a stream failed.

oneOf.description: Correlation ids start at 1, so `0` names nothing.

ThemeActionJson.description: What a [`GridJson::ThemeColor`] does to its channel.

TimestampJson.description:
An instant on the daemon's clock, as seconds and nanoseconds
since the Unix epoch.

description: One daemon frame body in its felis-json v1 form. A reader selects its branch on `kind` after checking `felis_json`, and ignores any property this document does not name: within the epoch a writer may add an optional field.
title: felis-json v1
